parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT jsonb_build_object('inspection',to_jsonb(i),'project',(SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM projects p WHERE p.id=i.project_id),'documents',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.stage,d.id) FROM (SELECT id,stage,original_filename,status,page_count,sha256 FROM documents WHERE project_id=i.project_id) d),'[]'::jsonb),'findings',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.created_at,f.id) FROM (SELECT findings.*,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('side',e.side,'document_id',e.document_id,'page_number',pg.page_number,'quote',e.quote,'bbox',e.bbox) ORDER BY e.side,e.id) FROM finding_evidence e JOIN document_pages pg ON pg.id=e.page_id WHERE e.finding_id=findings.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS evidence FROM findings WHERE inspection_id=i.id) f),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM inspections i WHERE i.id=$1::uuid) AS data
